name: lantern_bay
revision: r1 (2026-11-10): rebuilt on the true rule (critic pitch #8 fix): drowned only spawn in dark water, so a lit path through the deep is safe to swim; nobody turns into a drowned.
caption: why is grandma lighting the bottom of the sea 🏮
logline: Every night a boy's grandma swims out over a road of lanterns on the bay floor and adds one more; tonight he places the last one, and its light lands on the shipwreck where Grandpa disappeared, and on a chest he left there for her.
question: why tf are there 300 lanterns on the bottom of the sea?
premise: A line of 300 lanterns glows on the floor of a bay at night, running straight out from the dock. Every night, when she thinks the boy is asleep, Grandma swims out over it, dives at the end, puts down one more and sprints home. She says it's a road (he thinks: for fish). He once swam to the end at noon: past the last lantern the deep water is pitch black even by day, with tridents moving in it, and nothing is ever in the lit part (lucky water, he thinks). Grandpa used to dive at the old shipwreck out there; one night he didn't come back. His boat, the MAE, never came back either.
twist: The lanterns are a road to Grandpa. Drowned spawn only in dark water (vanilla: they need block light 0; 13 blocks down, the sky light is 2 even at noon, too dim to stop a spawn), so the only safe way across the deep bay is to light the floor ahead of you, one lantern at the edge of the dark each night, out of reach of the drowned already waiting in it. Tonight the line reaches the wreck. The boy places the last lantern, the light lands on the shipwreck's deck and on a chest; he opens it, and the chest screen's title says FOR MAE (a renamed chest), with one Heart of the Sea inside. Mae is Grandma (and the empty mooring's boat). Grandpa hid her present in the one place she would never look; she spent 300 nights building a road to it.

lines.text: There are / THREE HUNDRED / lanterns / on the bottom / of our BAY, / and Grandma / adds ONE / every NIGHT.
lines.say: There are three hundred lanterns on the bottom of our bay, and Grandma adds one every night.
lines.direction: all in one quick breath, bright and amazed, landing on the last word

lines.text: She thinks / I'm ASLEEP. / I'm NEVER asleep.
lines.direction: proud and cheeky, a little grin on the second sentence

lines.text: She swims / to the END, / puts ONE more, / and SPRINTS home.
lines.direction: quick, picking up speed through the list, impressed by the last part

lines.text: Grandma said, / "It's a ROAD." / For FISH, / I think.
lines.say: Grandma said, "It's a road." <short pause> For fish, I think.
lines.direction: bright, reporting it plainly, then totally sure of his own theory

lines.text: I swam out there / ONCE, / at NOON. / Past the end, / PITCH BLACK.
lines.direction: excited to tell it, then a little spooked on the last two words, still full volume
a real shiver of fear, quick, full volume

lines.text: NOTHING'S ever / in the LIT part. / LUCKY water.
lines.say: Nothing's ever in the lit part. Lucky water.
lines.direction: back to bright, shrugging it off, a happy theory

lines.text: Grandpa / used to dive / at the old SHIPWRECK. / One night, / he didn't / come BACK.
lines.say: Grandpa used to dive at the old shipwreck. <short pause> One night, he didn't come back.
lines.direction: still quick, matter-of-fact the way kids say sad things, a small drop on the last two words

lines.text: Tonight / Grandma said, / "LAST one." / And she took me / WITH her.
lines.say: Tonight Grandma said, "Last one." And she took me with her.
lines.direction: lifting, thrilled, the best night of his life

lines.text: We swam / the WHOLE road, / then DOVE.
lines.direction: fast and breathless with excitement, full volume
warm and steady, a gift, not an order; a small smile in it

lines.text: The light / hit the SHIPWRECK. / And a CHEST.
lines.direction: wonder, rising, the second sentence a discovery

lines.text: It said, / FOR MAE. / That's GRANDMA.
lines.say: It said, For Mae. <short pause> That's Grandma.
lines.direction: reading it slowly, then the realization, quiet surprise but still full voice, not whispered
lines.captions_extra: the chest screen title FOR MAE and the item name HEART OF THE SEA go in the caption track (the GUI title is small at phone size)
